{
  "name": "mm_pbd_bitmap_update",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Update a per-pool PBD/buffer bitmap and associated descriptor state when the supplied header indicates a buffer addition or removal.",
  "subsystem": "mm",
  "var_renames": {
    "v1": "pbd_id",
    "v2": "pool_idx",
    "v5": "bitmap_base",
    "v6": "byte_idx",
    "v7": "bit_mask",
    "v8": "old_bitmap_byte",
    "v9": "bitmap_byte_ptr",
    "v11": "desc_ptr",
    "v13": "state_ptr",
    "v17": "max_byte_idx",
    "v19": "min_byte_idx",
    "v21": "span_len"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 0, "meaning": "buffer/PBD id used as bit index into the pool bitmap"},
    {"offset": 2, "meaning": "set/clear action flag (add vs. remove buffer id)"},
    {"offset": 3, "meaning": "pool/queue/channel index into per-pool state and descriptor tables"},
    {"offset": 218, "meaning": "buffer-span descriptor length field"},
    {"offset": 220, "meaning": "count of marked PBD/buffer ids"},
    {"offset": 228, "meaning": "current minimum marked bitmap byte index"},
    {"offset": 229, "meaning": "current maximum marked bitmap byte index"}
  ]
}
